question: What are Qnami's current main opportunities? Give short bullet points
answer:
Here are Qnami’s current main opportunities, summarized in concise bullet points:

• Expansion into East Asia — Qnami has secured exclusive distribution agreements with Quantum Design Japan and Quantum Design Korea to bring its ProteusQ™ scanning NV magnetometer to vibrant research markets in Japan and South Korea ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2024/02/02/qnami-expands-into-japan-and-south-korea/?utm_source=openai)).

• Global distribution via HORIBA partnership — Through a strategic collaboration with HORIBA, Qnami gains access to a global distribution network (Europe, Asia, Americas), accelerating reach for its ProteusQ™ quantum microscope ([horiba.com](https://www.horiba.com/ind/scientific/resources/news/detail/news/7/2020/horiba-signs-strategic-cooperation-agreement-with-qnami-to-accelerate-scanning-nv-magnetometry-deve/?utm_source=openai)).

• Cryogenic and industrial spintronics applications — With Series A funding, Qnami is extending its technology into cryogenic environments and targeting industrial spintronics and quantum computing markets, beyond academic research ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2021/05/12/swiss-based-qnami-closes-4-million-chf-4-4-million-u-s-series-a-funding-round/?utm_source=openai)).

• AppLab service offering — Qnami’s AppLab enables external researchers and R&D engineers to submit samples or visit their facility for advanced quantum microscopy analysis, opening service-based revenue streams ([qidis25.com](https://www.qidis25.com/opportunities/UGFydGljaXBhdGlvbk9wcG9ydHVuaXR5OjE2OTA5MQ%3D%3D?utm_source=openai)).

• New product line: ProteusQ‑LT — The launch of ProteusQ‑LT, a cryogenic-capable version of their quantum microscope, expands Qnami’s product portfolio and addresses low-temperature research needs ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

• Diamond sensor and Foundry services — Qnami offers diamond-based NV sensor chips and probes (Quantilever, Quantum Foundry), enabling broader adoption in nanotechnology, life sciences, and precision imaging applications ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

Let me know if you'd like a deeper dive into any of these opportunities!
